name: Shimai Ryoujoku ~Watashi-tachi... Doushite Konna ni Nacchatta no...~
original_name: 姉妹陵辱 ～私達…どうしてこんなになっちゃったの…～

Two beautiful tanned siblings become futanari fornicators!
Maya and Meena from a certain known franchise.
Guide them on a choosable quest... to both extremes.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ067034.html]DLsite English[/url]]

引导她们踏上可以自由选择的旅程，一路走向两个极端。
